honest_findings: EN/ES/ZH: native exact unweighted-uniform kappa_mean is NEGATIVE, sign matches the published hyperbolic conclusion, and equals an independent same-definition oracle to ~1e-9 (exact-vs-exact, < 1e-4).

The MAGNITUDE |native - published| is ~0.04-0.06 (>1e-4) for all languages: the published reference is the WEIGHTED GraphRicciCurvature mean, a DIFFERENT ORC than the task's unweighted-hop spec. There is no published unweighted-uniform reference to grade |diff|<1e-4 against; per the STOP rule we do NOT let the native value stand in for a missing reference.

NL: dutch_edges_FINAL.csv does NOT exist; only the RAW dense dutch_edges.csv (500 nodes / 15368 edges, avg deg 61). Unweighted-uniform ORC on a dense graph yields POSITIVE curvature (kappa_mean=+0.0987) — an honest property of that input, not a bug; it disagrees in sign with the published (weighted, thresholded) NL.
acceptance: FAIL as literally written ('ALL FOUR PASS'): sign parity holds for 3/4 (EN/ES/ZH) vs the published hyperbolic sign and native==same-def-oracle to ~1e-9; NL sign mismatches (raw dense graph, no _FINAL). Magnitude |diff|<1e-4 vs the published reference fails for all four by definitional mismatch (unweighted-hop spec vs weighted reference).
native_equals_oracle_all_four: YES — native == same-definition oracle to <=1e-9 for ALL FOUR languages incl NL (native +0.098694937 == oracle +0.098694937). Native exact ORC independently confirmed correct; NL positivity is a true property of the raw dense graph.
slurm_determinism: Slurm stdout (cpu-ops jobs 2319-2322) and gpu-orangefs job 2325 (node gpuorangefs-5860-proxmox, scalar) are BITWISE-IDENTICAL to local runs; GPU node ran the same integer CPU binary, NO GPU kernel.
